evidence.quote: The remuneration package of employees generally includes salary and bonus elements. In general, the Group determines the remuneration package based on the qualifications, position and performance of its employees.
evidence.relevance: Discloses the specific mechanism for determining employee remuneration (salary/bonus) based on qualifications, position, and performance, satisfying the requirement for wage processing mechanisms.

evidence.quote: A liability is recognized for benefits accruing to employees (such as wages and salaries, annual leave, and sick leave) after deducting any amount already paid.
evidence.relevance: Describes the accounting mechanism for recognizing accrued wages and salaries, which constitutes a part of the wage processing/calculation rules.
